integrity: The proof is symbolic for all prime powers. Exhaustive graph construction for three small prime-field cases is included only as a consistency check. The originality comparison explicitly records the special degree calculations already present in the 2015 and 2017 classification papers.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to full matrix algebras over finite fields and the standard undirected nilpotent graph. Its proof uses the exact finite-field nilpotent-matrix count; no extension to matrices over nonfields is asserted.
title: Vertex degrees recover rank and nilpotency in finite-field matrix nilpotent graphs
